name: Aki
source:
Stubborn girl who Shikanosuke and Kirari saved from molester during their tour.

[spoiler]After watching Kirari perform during the Second Literature Club's tour in Osaka, Aki comes to admire Kirari and decides to begin her own musical career as a vocalist. She joins HAPPY CYCLE MANIA, but leaves to pursue a professional career as a solo artist.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/FCF18C07-581B-4B1C-990C-15776607D1FE/kira-kira-curtain-call]MangaGamer official website[/url].]
